اشتعلت (form VIII)
# اِشْتَعَلْتُ (ištaʕaltu) /iʃ.ta.ʕal.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِشْتَعَلَ (ištaʕala)
# اِشْتَعَلْتَ (ištaʕalta) /iʃ.ta.ʕal.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِشْتَعَلَ (ištaʕala)
# اِشْتَعَلْتِ (ištaʕalti) /iʃ.ta.ʕal.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِشْتَعَلَ (ištaʕala)
# اِشْتَعَلَتْ (ištaʕalat) /iʃ.ta.ʕa.lat/: third-perso
